title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs & Hidden Details You Probably Missed
description:
The best GTA 6 easter eggs and hidden details so far: the literal easter egg on a tower, Tommy Vercetti and Vice City callbacks, Liberty City links, Red Dead references, radio returns, and the small details that make Leonida feel alive. Confirmed facts and fan theories are labelled.
